message.content: From the data, it appears that Wolfgang is interested in purchasing expensive drums as part of an April Fool's joke. However, when asked about the drums he recently bought, Wolfgang revealed it was actually an April Fool's prank, as he wished he could afford them for real. In the context of his genuine interest in drums, Wolfgang seems enthusiastic about improving his drumming skills, as evidenced by his mention of planning to improve drumming skills as part of his New Year's resolutions. Therefore, despite the playful nature of his recent purchase, Wolfgang is clearly someone who values drumming and enjoys enhancing his drumming abilities.
